legend: Ahmad is passionate about physics, and recently he learned something new.
He learned that to keep an object from falling off the table, the center of mass of that object must be positioned on the table, even if the rest of this object is outside the table.
Ahmad was thrilled to learn this new concept, so he went to Ismail to share this idea.
Unfortunately, Ismail loves geometry and is a quick learner and quickly understood Ahmad's new idea and gave him a good problem.
The problem involves a circular table with radius R$$$R$$$ and a dish with a regular polygon shape of N$$$N$$$ sides, each side of length L$$$L$$$.
There are an unlimited number of dishes; The dishes can be placed anywhere on the table as long as they don't fall off the table and at least one side of them is parallel to the x-axis.
The task is to find the maximum possible area that can be covered using the dishes.
As a good friend of Ahmad, you want to help him solve this problem.
input: The first line contains one integer number T$$$T$$$ the number of testcases (1≤T≤106$$$1 \le T \le 10^6 $$$)
The following T$$$T$$$ lines contain 3 integers R,N,L$$$R, N, L$$$ (1≤R,L≤103$$$1 \le R,L \le 10^3$$$ , 3≤N≤100$$$3 \le N \le 100$$$)
output: For each test case, print a single value of the answer for the problem. Your answers must have a relative or absolute error of at most 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$.

legend.ai: Ahmad 热爱物理，最近他学到了一个新知识。
他了解到，要让一个物体不从桌上掉下来，该物体的质心必须位于桌面上，即使物体的其他部分伸出了桌面也可以。
Ahmad 很高兴学到了这个新概念，于是他去找 Ismail 分享这个想法。
不巧的是，Ismail 热爱几何，而且学习很快，很快就理解了 Ahmad 的新想法，并给了他一道有趣的题目。
这道题涉及一张半径为 R$$$R$$$ 的圆桌，以及一个有 N$$$N$$$ 条边的正多边形盘子，每条边的长度为 L$$$L$$$。
盘子的数量不限。只要盘子不会从桌上掉下来，且至少有一条边与 x 轴平行，就可以将盘子放在桌上的任意位置。
求使用这些盘子所能覆盖的最大面积。
作为 Ahmad 的好朋友，你想帮助他解决这个问题。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 T$$$T$$$，表示测试用例的数量(1≤T≤106$$$1 \le T \le 10^6 $$$)。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出该问题答案的一个值。你的答案的相对误差或绝对误差必须不超过 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$。
